Update5 February 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
Patch Notes — February 5, 2026
Adventurer's Guide (see newsboard): Divine Clock returns with hourly Phoenix Ashes caps, plus a new mentor/mentee GHA pickup. Guild XP cap relaxed and level 6/7 raid buffs retuned. Swirling Meadow housing opens Saturday. Powerstones 50 tokens, synthesis XP up, land prepay costs +10 bound certs per week.

📜 Patch Notes — February 5, 2026

Make sure to check out #💬︱newsboard! The Adventurer's Guide has been added as explained in the Newsboard article.

Event Changes

  • The Divine Clock is back and will grant 1x Phoenix Ashes every hour, up to 3 times a day
  • A new Mentor/Mentee quest has been added to GHA and can be picked up at General Merchant Enris in front of the dungeon.

Guild Changes

  • Guild Experience has been adjusted
  • The daily experience cap has been increased to allow guilds to level up with less timegating
  • Guild Buffs have been adjusted
  • Level 6: Now grants -20 seconds of rebirth trauma, and -40 seconds when 'active'
  • Level 7: Now grants -40 seconds of rebirth trauma, and -80 seconds when 'active'

Swirling Meadow Expansion

The Swirling Meadow has been expanded and its housing will open on SATURDAY. Precise time TBD in #🆕︱updates

Misc. Changes

  • Powerstones now cost 50 Activity Tokens (from 60)
  • Auroran Synthesis Stones/Shards will now grant more experience (x1.5)
  • Prepaying land will now cost an additional 10 Bound Tax Certs per week of prepay

== 📜 Patch Notes — February 5, 2026 ==

Make sure to check out #💬︱newsboard!
The Adventurer's Guide has been added as explained in the Newsboard article.

== Event Changes ==

* The Divine Clock is back and will grant 1x Phoenix Ashes every hour, up to 3 times a day
* A new Mentor/Mentee quest has been added to GHA and can be picked up at General Merchant Enris in front of the dungeon.

== Guild Changes ==

* Guild Experience has been adjusted

* The daily experience cap has been increased to allow guilds to level up with less timegating
* Guild Buffs have been adjusted

* Level 6: Now grants -20 seconds of rebirth trauma, and -40 seconds when 'active'

* Level 7: Now grants -40 seconds of rebirth trauma, and -80 seconds when 'active'

== Swirling Meadow Expansion ==

The Swirling Meadow has been expanded and its housing will open on SATURDAY. Precise time TBD in #🆕︱updates

== Misc. Changes ==

* Powerstones now cost 50 Activity Tokens (from 60)
* Auroran Synthesis Stones/Shards will now grant more experience (x1.5)
* Prepaying land will now cost an additional '''10 Bound Tax Certs''' per week of prepay
